scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement

grader.scenario: Streaming entertainment bundle (Netflix/Disney+) token link expired before account linking
grader.notes: Toby successfully accesses the partner API console to regenerate and SMS fresh Netflix and Disney Plus activation tokens, verifying live streaming. However, his customer service shows multiple severe faults: he ignores Hamza's distress, defers responsibility to third-party providers ('Netflix's problem, not S-Net's'), blames the customer callously for missing the initial email, fails to paraphrase, and repeats an email address question already answered.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am really annoyed about our entertainment add-on. We signed up for the S-Net Netflix and Disney Plus bundle ten days ago, but the activation link in the email expired...', Agent responds with verification questions without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only confirmed contact email at turn 48.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:10] Customer: 'I use hamza dot malik dot film at gmail dot com for Netflix.' followed by Agent at [07:20]: 'What was the email address you use for your Netflix account again?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:45] Agent: 'Third-party subscription tokens are generated and managed by Netflix and Disney partner APIs, so if the link expires, that's essentially Netflix's problem, not S-Net's.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [02:15] Agent: 'If you sat on the activation email for an entire week without clicking it, you only have yourself to blame.'
